name: Cornelio
source:
The first person Gilbert meets on Regulus island. He offers Gil a lift on his cart to the town of Ferio. After Schtoll is killed, he takes Gil and Norn to the nearest village from Veronica's hideout and bids them adieu. 

In game, he serves as the shopkeeper and his inventory expands as the player progresses through the story.

[Spoiler] Cornelio did not realise who Gil was initially, but after witnessing Schtoll's defeat at Gil's hand he realised he was looking at the Continent's famous demonslayer. Throughout the story, he has unshakeable faith that Gilbert will come good against the Witches. 

The ex-captain of the Lasfarr Paladin Goliath, he has retired from his ex-life and is a simple travelling merchant. When he meets his ex-subordinate again after Gil and his party defeat the paladin a second time, they talk about old times and the secret of Gil's newfound strength. [/Spoiler]
